name: People and characters (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 30 questions whose answer is a character from a story, a film, a cartoon or a myth, for Name that person (row 2.63): 4 very easy, 9 easy, 11 medium, 6 hard. Written because the question packs already held some 180 questions about real people but only about fifteen about characters. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-07, from its own knowledge plus the page each item cites: no API call. Every cited page was fetched on 2026-10-07 by a script that confirmed it loads and that its text contains the words named in the item's source note (a check that the page is about the fact, not a full fact-check). Then fact-checked item by item by a second, independent Claude pass on 2026-10-07 (every cited page re-fetched and read for the fact and for the wrong answers; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed). No line is quoted from any work beyond a three-word catchphrase; each question describes what the character does instead. A person still reviews it by playing.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.
